response.criterion: The sorting criterion appears to be the legislative framework under which the motor accident claims are assessed and settled.

groups.description: Documents in this group involve claims assessed and settled under the Motor Accident Injuries Act 2017, specifically focusing on settlements approved under section 6.23(2)(b).
